zh.title: 更清楚的版本号
zh.description: 版本统一显示为 Beta 0.2.0，后续更新按 0.2.1、0.2.2 递增

zh.title: 更顺手的首页
zh.description: 首页直接编写新对话，专注在你要做的事

zh.title: 项目和对话排列
zh.description: 选择项目不再新建空对话；项目、对话和置顶区支持保存排序

zh.title: 自定义 MCP 和技能
zh.description: 添加、开关和删除 MCP，管理技能，在输入框用斜杠调用

zh.title: 更整洁的对话菜单
zh.description: 视图、成果和审查入口集中到对话标题菜单

zh.title: 反馈更方便
zh.description: 提交反馈时可预览、删除或重新截图，失败后保留已填内容

zh.title: 模型发现与恢复
zh.description: 更稳定地发现已连接服务的模型；部分加密推理错误可在输出前自动恢复一次

en.title: Clearer version numbers
en.description: Versions now appear as Beta 0.2.0, followed by 0.2.1, 0.2.2 and later updates

en.title: Start from the home page
en.description: Compose a new conversation directly on the home page

en.title: Organize projects and conversations
en.description: Selecting a project no longer creates an empty conversation; project, conversation and pinned ordering is saved

en.title: Manage MCP and skills
en.description: Add, toggle and remove MCP servers, manage skills, and use them from slash commands

en.title: A tidier conversation menu
en.description: View options, artifacts and review are grouped in the conversation title menu

en.title: Easier feedback
en.description: Preview, remove or retake a screenshot, and keep your feedback if submission fails

en.title: Model discovery and recovery
en.description: More reliable discovery for connected providers, with one automatic recovery attempt for certain encrypted reasoning errors before output starts
